title: Coin Change
hints: Greedy (largest coin first) fails on coins [1, 3, 4] with amount 6. What smaller question, if answered for every smaller amount, would give you the answer for amount a?
dp[a] = 1 + min(dp[a - c] for c in coins if c <= a), with dp[0] = 0 and an 'impossible' sentinel for amounts nothing reaches. Fill a from 1 up to amount.
Use amount + 1 (or infinity) as the sentinel so min() needs no special cases, and map it back to -1 at the end. O(amount * len(coins)) time, O(amount) space.
